channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 7 Sep: Harare light drizzle · high 24° / low 15°
item.description: Harare: high 24°, low 15° (light drizzle) · Bulawayo: high 28°, low 14° (drizzle) · Mutare: high 24°, low 15° (overcast) · Gweru: high 28°, low 15° (light showers) · Masvingo: high 25°, low 14° (overcast) · Victoria Falls: high 34°, low 18° (overcast) Tsumo yezuva: Kure kwegava ndokusina mugariri. (The distance of the vulture is because no one stays there.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
